description: This class defines a supervisor actor for managing instances of ThingPersistenceActor in an Akka actor system. It handles creation, supervision, restart logic with exponential backoff, and exception handling related to things in a distributed IoT system.

classes.name: ThingSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor supervising individual ThingPersistenceActor instances, managing their lifecycle with restart strategies and exception handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props needed to instantiate a ThingSupervisorActor with provided pub/sub mediator, distributed publisher, and factory for persistence actor Props.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID (ThingId) based on the actor's name decoded from its path.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Provides the Props configuration for creating a new ThingPersistenceActor for a given ThingId.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Returns the shutdown behavior strategy for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a new builder for a ThingUnavailableException, optionally for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for exponential backoff from the system settings.
